tasks.gr10-cost-accounting-basics: Topic: Cost accounting basics. Cover manufacturing environment, direct materials, direct labour, factory overheads, unit cost. Ask about trading vs manufacturing costs and simple production cost calculations.
tasks.gr10-budgeting-examination-consolidation: Topic: Budgeting and examination consolidation. Cover cash budget, projected income statement, Grade 10 bookkeeping revision. Ask about budget variance, cash-flow reasoning, mixed end-of-year questions.
